messages:
oliver: Heads up — scheduling a late-night maintenance window to stage the egress ratecap integration + NIC driver micro-update. Target window: Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC. Rolling across AZs, intend zero broad outage but expect brief pod reschedules.

maya: how big are the cohorts? any forced GPU drains or will we do cordon-only for most nodes?

oliver: cohorts = 6 nodes / AZ. Flow: cordon -> drain (grace 30s) -> reboot -> sanity checks -> uncordon. For a handful of older NICs we'll do a soft drain to reattach GPU drivers, so those may evict jobs for ~2–5 min. No full-disk wipes.

jordan: can we keep Dedicated pool customers isolated? want to avoid cross-region failover unless absolutely necessary.

oliver: yes, Dedicated pools stay pinned. We'll route non-Dedicated burst traffic to us-west fallback region if a cohort goes below 12% spare. Router policy: prefer local, fallback to us-west2.

samira: cost question — will the fallback routing add significant egress costs? rough estimate?

jordan: rough calc: if we shift 15% traffic for 2 hours, egress delta ~ $3k - $6k depending on model footprint. We'll absorb under ops budget but flag finance if > $5k.

infra-bot: maintenance window created: id=MW-9245601112, start=172800s from now (approx), affected-tags=[gpu-nic-legacy, egress-ratecap].

sre_oncall: pinged for on-call coverage. I'll be awake for the first cohort and reachable via pager.

oliver: preflight checklist (run before window):
```
1) run `kubectl get nodes -l cohort=test -o wide` to confirm health
2) run `./scripts/egress-smoke --region us-east1 --dry-run`
3) push driver to canary nodes and validate `nicsync --status`
```

maya: adding post-checks: token latency smoke on embeddings route and a quick sample gen against the canary model. Will post results in #slo-monitor.

jordan: let's hold a 30m preflight sync 01:20 UTC in case we need last-minute rollback steps.

oliver: agreed. I'll update the infra status page and send customer comms draft to #customer-success for review. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good with plan.

samira: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: :thumbsup: oncall acknowledged.

infra-bot: NOTE: automated rollback hook enabled; if error-rate > 5% for 10m during a cohort, system will stop rollout and revert NIC driver on that cohort.
